repos_data.description: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice. Not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation.
A basic 3D scene implemented with various engines, frameworks or APIs.

AI画布：免费、轻量的本地 AI 创作工具，面向 AI短剧、图像与视频创作。集成无限画布、ComfyUI 工作流、分镜、图像/视频生成、视频剪辑与资产管理，支持 Agent、MCP 和 Blender。Free, lightweight, local-first AI canvas for AI short drama, creative workflows, storyboarding and video editing.
PicoBerry MCP server — an AI 3D workspace for games, VR, and beyond. Generate, remesh, texture, and animate 3D assets from any MCP client. Multi-engine, one API.

Cloud GPU rendering for Blender scenes and 3D models (GLB/FBX/USD/STL) for AI agents: MCP server, HTTP API, CLI. Product shots, turntables, animations from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor. Free to start (100 JPY with no card, 400 JPY more after saving a card), then 0.1 JPY per GPU-second.
